_doc: Durable selective-merge DECISIONS, per fork, per upstream commit. A gatekeeper decision is DATA, not a judgment to re-derive: without this record the daily tick re-asks the LLM about the same commit forever, and (because that judgment is a text completion) it can answer differently on different days. An entry here is final until a human edits it. Recognised decisions: 'skip' (deliberately not adopted) and 'adopt' (wanted; still goes through the normal cherry-pick + review path).

42b346e31887.reason: Extends the interactive `findlabel` command so `findlabel -glob <pattern> <n>` selects the nth matching label and moves the cursor box. This is an interactive layout-editing/UI affordance plus its documentation; magic's role in this distribution is batch DRC / extraction / GDS streamout driven by scripts, which never invokes findlabel. Adopting it would add carried delta with no signoff-path effect. Re-evaluate only if an automated flow starts using findlabel.
